dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.platformui.getmodaldialogshell>
<!description: Replace IWorkbenchSite.getShell() with PlatformUI.getWorkbench().getModalDialogShellProvider().getShell() to retrieve the modal dialog shell provider's shell.>
<!severity: WARNING>
getSite().getShell()
=> org.eclipse.ui.PlatformUI.getWorkbench().getModalDialogShellProvider().getShell()
;;
summary: Replaces direct `getSite().getShell()` calls with the modern `PlatformUI.getWorkbench().getModalDialogShellProvider().getShell()` to ensure correct modal dialog shell acquisition.
